verdict.rationale: The only programmatic surface in the evidence is coding-scoped: a Codex SDK for automating coding tasks, including CI jobs, plus a CLI with flags such as --search and /memories. The docs say the CLI lacks the visual preview and annotation features of the UI, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec. Missing for 10: any documented API covering UI features such as image generation, Work documents/decks, Browser, Computer Use, Voice, projects and scheduled tasks; a published API spec; evidence of overall UI/API parity; independent corroboration.
